description: Expected differences between the legacy golden output and the v6 engine. The golden files are never edited; a difference is accepted only when a rule below matches it, and every rule cites the requirement or defect that makes v6 differ. Read by tools/oracle/compare.ts. 'legacy' lists the golden values (as written by run.js), 'v6' is the value v6 must produce instead, and 'paths' (optional) limits a rule to output paths matching these patterns, where * matches one path segment and ** any number.

rules.why: A missing value is null in v6. v5 wrote NaN, mostly for averages over no values.
A missing value is null in v6. v5 wrote undefined, for example an OPR a team does not have.
A missing value is null in v6. v5 could produce Infinity from a division by zero.

The 2025 pipeline put divByZero: 150000 beside options instead of inside them, so v5 ignored it and wrote "N/A". The v1 → v2 converter moves it into options, so v6 writes the value the configuration asked for.
